$comment: CSS files that still set `width` on `.ant-modal` from product or shell code, which bypasses the closed width tiers in platform/ui/components/modal. One entry per file; the number is how many rules in that file set the modal's width. The tier set itself (compact 420 / standard 520 / expanded 720 / maximum 860 / full 1280) is enforced by Modal.tsx and the pixel table in Modal.test.tsx; this list exists only so a known override does not turn the gate red on the day the guard lands. Delete an entry in the same commit that removes its override, and lower the number when a file keeps fewer of them: a stale entry fails the guard, both directions. A rule that only narrows the dialog (`max-width` with a theme token) is not debt and is not counted. This file lives outside platform/ui/components on purpose: the product line that removes the override must be able to strike the line without touching the component directory. Currently empty: the one override that existed (macroIndicatorDrawer.css, removed in 68ed070fe) struck its line, and the empty list keeps both directions running — the next `.ant-modal { width }` fails immediately instead of slipping in.
